headline: CMS INDUSLAW advises Anveshan on ₹150 crore Series B fundraise
sum: Anveshan Farm Technologies raised ₹150 crore in Series B funding led by Vertex Ventures and IFC Co-Invest, with participation from Swiggy co-founder Sriharsha Majety and existing shareholders. The clean-label, traditional-foods company plans to deploy capital toward manufacturing, product innovation, and omnichannel expansion.
implication: Series B venture rounds in agri-tech and direct-to-consumer food brands increasingly attract strategic co-investors from adjacent consumer platforms; counsel should map founder equity dilution and governance rights against Series B liquidation preferences in the Articles.
detail: Anveshan, founded in 2020 by IIT Guwahati alumni Kuldeep Parewa, Akhil Kansal, and Aayushi Khandelwal, specializes in traceable, traditionally crafted foods including A2 Desi Ghee (bilona method), cold-pressed oils, wild forest honey, and superfoods. The Series B round was anchored by Vertex Ventures (US-based emerging markets VC) and IFC Co-Invest (World Bank affiliate), with strategic participation from Sriharsha Majety (Swiggy co-founder), signaling cross-sector consumer brand validation. Proceeds will fund manufacturing capacity expansion, R&D acceleration, and multi-channel (online and offline) distribution.
